purpose: Uses a narrowly scoped LLM extraction call to tag each enquiry with intent, urgency and service interest, validated against a fixed label set before saving.

serviceInterest.description: Must equal one of the configured service names or 'unknown'

configurationFields.description: Below this, label as 'other' and flag for staff review

permissionsRequired: Send enquiry text to the configured LLM provider (requires intake ai_data_consent=true)

testCases.description: Message 'Is there a demo class this Saturday for the Target batch?'
testCases.expectedOutcome: intent=demo-request; serviceInterest matches the Target batch name

testCases.description: LLM returns a label outside the enum
testCases.expectedOutcome: Rejected by validation; stored as other with review flag
Lead remains stored; classification marked pending; no crash

knownLimitations: Contract only: n8n blueprint JSON not yet built and exported (Phase B).
English-only prompt; mixed-language messages may get lower confidence.
rollbackApproach: Deactivate the workflow; leads continue without tags and staff triage manually.
